C1129.title: Fujian Putian Chen's Fake Order Scam Case
C1129.summary: Chen established an online fake order platform, recruiting individuals to conduct fraudulent order brushing for online stores. Between 2020 and 2023, a total of over 5.42 million fake orders were placed, resulting in illegal profits exceeding 7.8 million yuan. Chen was sentenced to one year and six months in prison for the crime of false advertising.
